name: Weekly newsletter
tagline: A short, polished newsletter goes out every Monday on autopilot
description: Tell us the topics and the tone. Your team researches each one, writes the issue, an editor polishes it, and a draft lands in your inbox every Sunday night for a quick proofread before Monday's send.
starterPrompt: Draft a short weekly newsletter for me about AI agents, open source, and what's new in self-hosted tools. Three short sections, ~120 words each, in a conversational tone. Save it as a markdown file titled 'Newsletter — <this week's date>'.
defaultGoal: Ship a polished newsletter every Monday with zero last-minute scrambling.
